# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration 5. Parent = cand_0003 (current best, val 0.637). cand_0004 (an executed
"generalization self-test" step in task_template.md) was REJECTED (-0.077, broke 7 passing
tasks) and fully reverted — I did NOT re-introduce it. Scoring is HARD restriction: the
agent's FINAL code is text-substituted onto two hidden input files (same layout, different
data/row-counts) and re-run; a task counts only if ALL 3 match answer_position.
Signatures: `[1,0,0]`/`[1,0,1]`/`[1,1,0]` = passes preview, fails the hidden re-run
(generalization/edge-case gap); `[0,0,0]` = wrong on the preview too (comprehension error
or environment fault).

## Diagnosis summary (THIS iteration's ./trajectories/, 33 failing)
I dumped instruction + answer_position + content-preview + final emitted code + feedback
for all 33 fails and clustered them:
- **Generalization-gap `[1,0,*]` (9 tasks):** 250-20, 30930, 32975, 42930, 48983, 49782,
  53305, 58484, 58890. Operation correct on preview; fails on hidden data.
- **Comprehension / ambiguous-spec `[0,0,0]` (~15):** 269-44, 146-49, 157-4, 254-34,
  398-14, 413-15, 577-40, 34-5, 50526, 55039, 53449, 32468, 39946, 6698, 50755, 585-41 …
- **Environment / eval faults (~6, handed back, NOT optimized against):** 45944 & 14207
  (formula recalc — feedback says so), 53062 (48k-row recalc), 4225 & 55258 (output
  provably reproduces the instruction's own stated example yet `[0,0,0]` — grader/type
  fault), 55912 (unreadable xlsx).
- **Volatile "current date" (34-5, 32023):** "current month"/TODAY() resolves differently
  at grade time (today=2026-08-02) vs benchmark creation. Not safely fixable in prose.

## Ranked issue list (leverage first)
| rank | cluster | tasks (evidence) | root cause | tag | action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Match/group/lookup keys mismatch across value TYPE on hidden data | 48983 `[1,1,0]`, 58890 `[1,0,0]`, 58484 `[1,0,0]`, 250-20 `[1,0,1]`, 49782 `[1,0,1]`, 32975 `[1,0,0]` | Keys/comparisons built on the raw stored type — `str(value)` keying or a raw `==` — so int `1`, float `1.0` and text `"1"` become three different keys. Preview stores one type and matches; a hidden file storing the same value as float/text silently misses → wrong value or unmatched `#N/A`/blank | KNOWLEDGE (additive worked-caution, narrowing to key/compare code) | **Edit 1**: canonicalize keys/comparisons by value (prompt.md) |
| — | Comprehension / ambiguous-spec `[0,0,0]` | see list above | Emitted code already generalizes but implements the WRONG operation; no gold in traces → no interpretation is VERIFIABLE | SKIPPED (unverifiable — would fail VERIFIED/SAFE) | not edited |
| — | Boundary / trailing-segment `[1,0,*]` (30930, 42930, part of 32975) | already addressed by cand_0002/0003 contiguous-run + before-first/after-last prose; agent still trips | KNOWLEDGE (already present) | not re-stated (SKILL: don't restate a rule the agent has) |
| — | Environment / eval faults | 45944, 14207, 53062, 4225, 55258, 55912 | Infra, not a prompt defect | ENVIRONMENT (handed back) | not worked around |

## Change made this iteration (ONE edit — ADDITIVE, bounded, verified)
| edit | class | file | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | KNOWLEDGE + worked example (SKILL menu items 4 & 5) | prompt.md (new bullet after the composite-key bullet) | "CANONICALIZE ANY KEY OR COMPARISON BY VALUE, NOT BY STORED TYPE": when looking up / matching / grouping / de-duplicating / detecting run boundaries, values equal in Excel must compare equal in code — don't key on `str(value)` and don't `==` mixed types (`str(1)`≠`str(1.0)`≠`"1"`; `1 == "1"` is False); coerce numeric parts to a number, strip+casefold text, reduce dates to their calendar day. States a GENERAL rule over the input class; no task id/value/answer. | BOUNDED — additive rule that fires only in key/compare code. Canonicalization can only make values that ARE equal compare equal; it never splits a key or merges two genuinely-distinct values, so it cannot flip a match a passing task currently gets right. Passing lookup/group tasks are `[1,1,1]` across three varying-data instances → their keys already align, so nothing changes for them. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 48983 `[1,1,0]`: key fn is literally `str(v).strip().casefold()`. `str(1)`="1" but
  `str(1.0)`="1.0" → the brand/category key that matched in instances 1–2 misses in
  instance 3 whenever the hidden file stores a number as a float, writing `#N/A`. With the
  edit the agent coerces the numeric key part to a number first, so the match survives.
- 58484 `[1,0,0]`: compares `original == operator_number` / `calling == operator_number`
  with raw `==`. If the transfer number is stored as int in one instance and text (or
  float) in another, the comparison is False → the count is wrong. The edit forbids the
  raw mixed-type `==` and requires numeric coercion.
- 250-20 `[1,0,1]`, 49782 `[1,0,1]`, 58890 `[1,0,0]`, 32975 `[1,0,0]`: all build their
  group/lookup/run-boundary key via `str(...)`/raw compare (grep-confirmed). Same failure
  class; the edit fixes the shared root cause.
- Scorer check: the fix changes only WHICH source rows match/group — it writes the same
  computed value type into answer_position as before; it does not change the output
  contract the passing tasks satisfy.

## Confirmed-SAFE checks I ran
- Placeholders: task_template.md untouched; all six required placeholders + `{max_turns}`
  present. prompt.md contains zero `{`/`}`.
- Edit is ADDITIVE (a new bullet); no existing rule reworded looser, none deleted, no
  global decision/permission/refusal rule altered. No task-specific literal.
- Did NOT re-add cand_0004's rejected executed self-test (broke 18137, 253-22, 347-49,
  47699, 50486, 53957, 56561). Did NOT touch the "prefer literal values" line (5 passing
  formula tasks: 35747/37962/45581/49237/54675) or re-tighten verify item (a) (399-14
  regression under cand_0001).

## Process & features used
- Read all cross-iteration files (LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP/prior PROCESS). Compact python dump
  of all 33 failing traces to /tmp; grep-confirmed the `str(...)`/raw-`==` key pattern in
  the six generalization-gap tasks before editing. No subagents needed at this scale.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why) — and the PLATEAU signal
- Comprehension / ambiguous-spec `[0,0,0]` (the largest remaining cluster): the emitted
  code already generalizes; it implements the WRONG operation. No general prose rule fixes
  a specific misreading without leaking a task-specific interpretation, and there is NO gold
  in the traces to VERIFY a direction — every such edit fails the VERIFIED + SAFE tests.
  Padding an already-long prompt (read by a model less robust on long context) with abstract
  comprehension prose is the documented way to waste an iteration; declined.
- Boundary/trailing-segment prose is already present (cand_0002/0003) and converted its
  convertible tasks; restating it is out of scope per the system-prompt SKILL.
- Environment/eval faults (45944, 14207, 53062, 4225, 55258, 55912) and volatile-date
  (34-5, 32023) handed back, not worked around.
- PLATEAU: after cand_0003 (+0.066) and the REJECTED cand_0004 (structural escalation of
  the same generalization cluster), the clean prose-fixable surface is nearly exhausted.
  This iteration extracts the one remaining VERIFIABLE, bounded generalization sub-pattern
  (type-canonicalized keys). If it doesn't clear the bar, the residual is the comprehension
  ceiling, which prose cannot safely close without ground truth — next iteration should hand
  that ceiling back with the evidence rather than ship speculative comprehension prose.
